item.title: Continuous Performance Monitoring Framework
item.description:
Student project for Ericsson, Karlskrona · Team of 5 · Feb – May 2026 · Grade A

A feedback-controlled framework for continuous performance monitoring — detects saturation points, tracks trends, and visualises system health in real time.

  • Built a feedback-controlled load-testing framework in Python with Locust
  • Automated saturation detection, trend reporting, and history storage in SQLite
  • Containerised the system with Docker/Minikube; built live dashboards in Grafana and Prometheus
  • Acted as Project Owner for the first and last sprints; contributed code and reviews across nearly all modules
  • Delivered every client and academic demo as lead presenter

Stack: Python, Locust, Grafana, Prometheus, SQLite, Docker, Minikube, pytest, Cypress, GitLab

item.title: Graph Editor
item.description:
Individual project · Grade A

An interactive graph visualiser and editor for creating, exploring, and analysing networks such as knowledge graphs, dependencies, and social interactions.

  • Designed and built an interactive graph visualiser/editor for knowledge and dependency graphs
  • Implemented a TypeScript front end backed by Neo4j queries
  • Learned Neo4j and TypeScript from scratch for this project and delivered a fully working tool

Stack: JavaScript, TypeScript, Neo4j

item.title: Restaurant Ordering System & Kitchen Dashboard
item.description:
Team of 5 (first-year project) · Grade A (individual & team)

A small ordering website for customers, paired with a kitchen dashboard to track incoming orders and mark them complete.

  • Built a Flask ordering site plus a real-time kitchen dashboard for order tracking
  • Tested with pytest and shipped in Docker
  • Led planning and reporting and contributed code across nearly every part of the project

Stack: Python, Flask, SQLite, pytest, Docker
